Divination6.formation: NEW fixed30foot-radius sphere centered on a perceived point within60feet and caster line of effect; concentration up to60elapsed seconds. The chosen center must be on the caster's actual current plane. Its insight benefit reaches eligible creatures with a body portion in the sphere and center-to-body line of effect, including the caster if eligible. It is a nonphysical magical zone, not illumination, cover, a wall or a new perception sense. It does not move with the caster.
Divination6.events: Check actual current plane, geometry, line of effect and effective alignment when each attack/save/task roll event is created. Entering/leaving, changing alignment or losing local eligibility changes future roll eligibility without a free new roll, spell cast or Action. No entry pulse, charge reserve, duration gift or lasting buff is acquired. Extra turns can contain genuine eligible rolls but create no special bonus budget. Partial local suppression removes only the affected current benefit; its clock and parent concentration continue.
Divination6.ending: Ordinary expiry, concentration ending, replacement or an actual eligible whole-source removal ends the zone. It has one rank6 parent record, not a list of separately cast spells. A fixed zone with no independent creature-target branch is ineligible for Xi's creature-branch ending. It gives no distant roll readout or retroactive revision of a completed roll.

Conjuration8.destinationAndSourceChoice: NEW full portal operation, not an insight zone substituted for travel. Choose an actually different plane and a specific destination place whose real physical layout the caster has personally perceived, either by visiting or through a source-authorized ordinary visual view such as Planar Window. A mere map name, secondhand direction, imagined ideal, omen or invented cosmology is insufficient to locate an endpoint. The Director records genuine stable origin/destination plane identities privately; distinct labels alone cannot pass the different-plane condition. Choose exact two opening faces and arrival spaces before commitment. Unknown or changed real destination conditions are resolved after paid commitment with no diagnostic report or substitute plane.
Conjuration8.newEmpowermentInterpretation: NEW consequential interpretation for joint review: the spell temporarily makes the selected destination plane empower creatures matching the cast's snapshotted pair, rather than requiring or asserting that the plane is eternally aligned. While this Nexus operates, its +2 insight benefit applies to every actually eligible creature physically on that destination plane, including preexisting inhabitants and enemies, whenever a qualifying roll occurs. This is deliberately plane-wide to retain the full destination-empowerment promise; it is not reduced to a receiving-pad buff. Evaluate it on actual roll events, without scanning or revealing a population. This temporary magical effect establishes no permanent planar affinity, creation history, soul jurisdiction, objective Wheel mapping, rest rule or moral allegiance. The scope and interpretation are NEW and unadopted, requiring explicit GPT review and later balance assessment.
Conjuration8.openings: NEW concentration up to600elapsed seconds. Form two fixed, visible vertical rectangular openings, each10feet wide and15feet high, linked face-to-face with a recorded neutral orientation. The whole origin opening and its five-foot-deep receiving clearance must be within120feet and caster line of effect. The remote opening/receiving clearance use the exact known destination layout rather than imaginary cross-plane line of effect. Both openings initially need actual unoccupied clear physical aperture volume and a front-side receiving region at least10feet wide,15feet high and5feet deep. A larger traveler needs additional actual receiving clearance at transit. An unsupported but otherwise empty fitting destination is permitted; the spell creates no floor, flight, breathing protection or environmental immunity. A traveler arriving without real support immediately follows its actual Falling/other movement rules. A hidden failure prevents the complete portal pair and empowerment after costs are committed. The spell creates no body in the gap and no third intermediate transit plane.
Conjuration8.transit: While both mouths are operative, a whole actual body may cross by spending five feet of available real movement from an adjacent reachable side; the body and its carried noncreature gear must fit the opening and legal receiving space. Ordinary physically permitted squeezing can apply if it truly allows that whole body through, without automatic resizing. Actual independent forced movement can carry a body through if that movement reaches/crosses the opening and all its own permissions remain legal; the Nexus itself compels nothing and grants no free movement. Separate riders/passengers/carried creatures remain separate bodies. A genuinely inseparable group declared by its actual transport situation is one atomic transaction and every body must fit and satisfy its own blockers. Otherwise bodies cross in a fixed actual event order and occupancy can stop later travelers. Real independent objects/projectiles can cross if they fit and possess actual movement/force. No remote stock is duplicated or pulled through merely by opening the gate. NEW receiving placement: before a particular transit commits, declare the receiving whole-body footprint/pose on the exit's front side, with the nearest edge of that footprint no more than5feet from the exit plane and every body point on the receiving side. It must be a real perceived or personally known location through the actual opening view, fit the current whole body/group and obey the declared exit orientation; it is not a remote retarget beyond the receiving space. Hidden/intervening occupancy is checked after a valid commitment and can defeat that paid movement without a substitute. All bodies retain their actual anatomy, dimensions, load and gear; no slot is reserved against other travelers. The five-foot minimum setup clearance alone does not prove that a Large or larger body fits.
Conjuration8.rangeSightAndAttacks: The open gateway transmits ordinary light and sound along the real unobstructed route through its two apertures. This is a view of the actual destination, not a remote caster body or origin substitution. NEW a genuinely physical nonspell projectile or thrust may pass through the opening with its own legal attack, visibility and remaining range: measure the actual route to the entrance plus from the exit, with zero additional path length for the paired mouth transition. The real attack retains its dealer/root, defenses and event identity. This includes a physical weapon with separately legal magical enhancement; it does not turn its attack into a second cast. A spell or other effect with an actual same-plane targeting/origin restriction keeps it; the gateway does not waive components, concentration, source-origin, target-type or planar limits or authorize casting from the remote mouth. An effect needs its own genuine authority for any nonphysical cross-plane delivery.
Conjuration8.preventionAndFailure: Test each actual transported body's origin and destination against applicable teleport/planar-transition prevention, including Dimensional Anchor, and the actual distinction between voluntary and involuntary travel in the preventing source. This operation is a planar transition and teleportation for these NEW Nexus transit rules; no imaginary intervening-world path is tested. A known invalid transit is not begun. If an obstacle/blocker becomes effective after a valid movement commitment, that transaction stays wholly at its actual origin with already-spent movement/resources retained; no nearest-safe relocation, new destination, partial body or retry occurs. Obstruction of a mouth can block a current transit without ending the entire spell. The gateway grants no universal ward bypass; ordinary Banishment's special terminal closure is unrelated to voluntary Nexus transit.
Conjuration8.suppressionAndClosure: Local suppression intersecting an opening makes that mouth unavailable for transit while the original clock continues. Local suppression at a beneficiary suspends only that creature's current insight expression. Suppression of the caster alone does not automatically end an already established concentration unless its actual source says so. An effect expressly suppressing the entire Nexus suspends both mouths and empowerment within its actual scope. Nothing queues missed moves or bonuses. On expiry, concentration ending, replacement or eligible parent removal, both mouths and all Nexus insight benefits end. Every completed traveler/object remains at its actual current location; there is no automatic return journey, refund or rescue. A transit resolves atomically before or after a closing event under actual event order, never half inside a severed body. If an endpoint's actual containing place ceases to exist, this Nexus ends rather than inventing a location to hold it. Existing source-specific mandatory body settlement remains that other source's responsibility.
Conjuration8.removalAndCustody: Both mouths are addressable manifestations of the same rank8 parent for an actually eligible dispel; ending the parent at either operative mouth ends both and the empowerment. It does not end an independent other Nexus. Plane-wide empowerment is one continuous zone-like effect with no independent creature-target branch, so Xi cannot end the whole plane effect by targeting an arbitrary beneficiary. Ordinary actually applicable narrow suppression/removal sources retain their own scope. All real cargo, bodies, personal custody, permits and institutional consequences remain real on the side where they are. Neither an unseen native population nor private plane facts are reported by the benefit.
